stories.title: CNN, MS NOW and Politico file lawsuit against Trump's White House ban

en.title: CNN, MS NOW and Politico file lawsuit against Trump's White House ban
en.summary: Three news outlets filed a lawsuit against the Trump administration after being banned from White House access, alleging violations of First Amendment and due process rights. Other major networks suspended their White House TV coverage in solidarity with the banned outlets.

stories.title: Celia Birtwell ‘humanises’ Burberry in London fashion week closing show

en.title: Celia Birtwell 'humanises' Burberry in London fashion week closing show
en.summary: Textile designer Celia Birtwell collaborated with Burberry designer Daniel Lee on a one-off collection that closed London fashion week, incorporating her signature florals and prints with the brand's luxury checks.

en.title: Vance defends Trump over press ban and removal of 'propaganda' from the White House
en.summary: Vice President Vance defended restrictions on media access to the White House, arguing that banned outlets can still report on the executive branch from outside the premises.

stories.title: First person charged in UK over 1994 Rwanda genocide

en.title: First person charged in UK over 1994 Rwanda genocide
en.summary: A person has been charged in the United Kingdom in connection with the 1994 Rwanda genocide, marking the first such charge brought by the country.

stories.title: Trump lashes out at news outlets over lawsuit challenging White House media ban

en.title: Trump lashes out at news outlets over lawsuit challenging White House media ban
en.summary: Trump criticized news outlets that filed legal action against the White House media access restrictions.

en.title: White House shredded for promoting its own news app after Trump's media ban: 'State run media'
en.summary: The White House promoted its official app as an alternative news source following the administration's ban on certain media outlets from White House grounds, drawing criticism for resembling state-controlled media.

en.title: US TV networks suspend White House pool coverage over Trump media ban
en.summary: Major US television networks declined to provide White House coverage after the Trump administration banned certain media outlets, including CNN, from accessing the grounds.

en.summary: A reporter covering London Fashion Week identified five emerging seasonal trends as the event concluded, including minimal eye makeup and tassel embellishments across garments.

en.title: Death of Cindy Crawford's son Presley Gerber being investigated as suspected overdose
en.summary: The death of model Presley Gerber is being investigated as a suspected overdose, with his family requesting privacy during this difficult period.

stories.title: First UK charges brought over 1994 Rwanda genocide

en.title: First UK charges brought over 1994 Rwanda genocide
en.summary: A 65-year-old man formerly known as Dr Vincent Bajinya has been charged with seven offences related to the Rwandan genocide, marking the first such prosecution in the UK. He is scheduled to appear at Westminster Magistrates' Court.

stories.title: Rwandan man charged with crimes linked to 1994 genocide in first case brought in UK

en.title: Rwandan man charged with crimes linked to 1994 genocide in first case brought in UK
en.summary: A 65-year-old man formerly known as Dr Vincent Bajinya, now living in London, has been charged with seven offences related to the 1994 Rwandan genocide in the first UK prosecution of this type. He will appear in court on Tuesday.

stories.title: UK brings first charges over 1994 Rwandan genocide

en.title: UK brings first charges over 1994 Rwandan genocide
en.summary: A Rwandan man has become the first person in the UK to face charges related to the 1994 genocide. He is accused of participating in the killings.

en.summary: The UK prime minister will meet Donald Trump in person for the first time at a UN meeting in New York to discuss artificial intelligence threats.

stories.title: France calls on EU to take immediate action to lower energy prices

en.title: France calls on EU to take immediate action to lower energy prices
en.summary: France's President Macron has requested that the European Union implement measures to reduce energy prices immediately. He also asked the European Commission to postpone new methane regulations by one year.

en.summary: The United Arab Emirates and Qatar are calling for improved relations with Iran amid the ongoing regional conflict. The UAE seeks a new approach while Qatar proposes establishing a regional security framework.

en.title: Meta leads tech rally as oil prices fall
en.summary: Technology stocks, led by Meta, gained ground as Brent crude oil prices declined. The price drop reflected market expectations about a potential meeting between Donald Trump and Iran's president.

stories.title: ‘Stop the bleeding’: Republicans tell Trump to ban US diesel exports

en.title: 'Stop the bleeding': Republicans tell Trump to ban US diesel exports
en.summary: Republican legislators from rural areas are urging Trump to prohibit diesel exports in response to a fuel price crisis. The crisis is attributed to the president's Iran war policy.
